newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALIAN OIL CONSUMPTION FELL 2.3 PCT IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: ITALIAN OIL CONSUMPTION FELL 2.3 PCT IN JULY.

text.p: Italian oil consumption fell 2.3 percent year on year in July to 7.9 million tonnes, according to data from trade body Unione Petrolifera (UP).
This was mainly due to a continuing fall in demand for fuel oil by the power generating sector, down 10.3 percent in the month to 1.7 million tonnes, UP said in a statement.
But demand for gasoline and diesel for vehicles rose by 1.2 percent to 1.6 million tonnes and 2.2 percent to 1.4 million tonnes respectively.
UP said July sales of lead-free gasoline totalled 831,000 tonnes, a rise of 11.7 percent on July 1996, and representing 51.4 percent of gasoline consumption.
In the first seven months of 1997, total oil consumption was some 53.4 million tonnes, a fall of 3.6 percent against the same period last year.
